 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 2725 of 2024
 1. Budu Munda @ Sagar Purti
 2. Pairo Nag
 3. Birsa Purti
 4. Suleman Munda
 5. Emmanuel Nag ...Petitioners
 Versus

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
 For the Petitioners : Mr. A.K. Kashyap, Sr. Advocate
 For State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, Advocate

For the informant : Mr. Sushant Kr. Sinha, Advocate  ---
02/16.05.2024 Heard the learned senior counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned counsel for the respondent State and the informant.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Pathalgada P.S. case No. 04 of 2024 for the offence registered under sections 376, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, section 3/4 Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate,
1st Class, Chatra.
3. Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that if any allegations are there of relationship that is against the Lakhan Purty.
So far as these petitioners are concerned there were general and omnibus allegations against them and the case is registered under the Indian Penal Code and Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practices Act.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that allegations are there.
5. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 further added that there are allegations against all the accused persons.

Looking into the First Information Report it transpires that the allegations is made of establishing relationship by one Lakhan Purty and so far as these petitioners are concerned there are general and omnibus allegations.
7.
In the attending facts and circumstances, I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

. Accordingly, the petitioners, above named, are hereby directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today, and in the event of their surrender/arrest, the petitioners,
above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Chatra, in connection with Pathalgada P.S. case No. 04 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) MM 2 of 2 Budu Munda @ Sagar Purti vs The State Of Jharkhand ...Opposite ... on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160651009/
